These are RECONSTRUCTIONS, not captures.

uae-accuracy-report.txt beside this file is real text off a real phone. This
file is not: it is one message per bank per kind, written in each bank's
register from the formats that ARE in the real corpus, plus the conventions
those banks are known to use — ADCB's abbreviations, RAKBANK's DD-MMM-YY
dates, ADIB's Covered Card and profit wording, Wio's bullet-masked tails.

Treat a message here as a hypothesis about a format, not as evidence of one.
When a real message from one of these banks turns up, it belongs in a real
corpus file and the guess here should be replaced by it. Every message below
is asserted individually in parser.test.js.
